address: Praza do Matadoiro 3, Santiago de Compostela, 15704, Spain
bio: An unusual bistro-style restaurant located in a small square close to the centre of the city. The chef at the helm creates dishes that have the distinct feel of his native Peru, combined with influences he has amassed on his travels around the globe and less popular fish species sourced from the auction. Here, they say that “every dish is a journey”, hence the desire to explain the provenance of each one on the menu (Peru, Colombia, Ecuador, Galicia, Basque Country etc). The cuisine is focused around two menus: 7 Destinos and 9 Destinos. Given its small size, it is advisable to book ahead....
